title: Measurability of the approximate-tangent projection of an integer multiplicity triple (Cauchy–Binet)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P arbitrary, and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple of dimension n in U (IMRep U n). For x ∈ ℝ^P let T_x := approxTangentPlane n M x: the approximate tangent n-plane of M at x when one exists (it is then unique), and {0} otherwise. Let p_x : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be the orthogonal projection onto T_x (starProjection). Then x ↦ p_x ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) is almost-everywhere measurable (AEMeasurable, Borel σ-algebra) with respect to Hⁿ⌞M = μHE[n].restrict M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier)
